Sample SingleCellExperiment Object

Source: R/data.R
sample_cytof_sce.Rd

A SingleCellExperiment object containing the CyTOF data with multiple assays and metadata.

Usage

sample_cytof_sce

Format

A SingleCellExperiment object with:

Dimensions

5 markers × 1,000 cells

Assays

  • norm: Asinh-transformed expressions

  • raw: Original expressions (reverse-transformed)

  • scaled: Z-score normalized expressions

colData

Cell metadata including sample_id, batch, and cell_type

rowData

Marker metadata including marker names and classes

Source

Created from sample_cytof_data

Examples

data(sample_cytof_sce)
dim(sample_cytof_sce)
assayNames(sample_cytof_sce)
colData(sample_cytof_sce)[1:5,]
